expected.stdout:
Usage: env-lane [options] [command]

Workspace-aware dotenv injection and development vault tooling.

Options:
  -V, --version                                 output the version number
  -c, --config <file>                           env-lane config file
  -b, --build <name>                            build selector value
  --cwd <dir>                                   base directory for config discovery and relative CLI paths
  --format <format>                             output format (text, json, dotenv)
  --json                                        use json output format (shorthand for --format json)
  --non-interactive                             disable prompts and require every decision explicitly
  --no-prefix                                   do not include diagnostic scope prefixes
  -h, --help                                    display help for command

Commands:
  packages [options]                            List discovered workspace packages. Falls back to root in single-package projects.
  resolve-target [options] <target>             Resolve a target alias/name/path to a package.
  files|env-files [options] [target]            List dotenv files in injection order.
  print|env-json [options] <target>             Print final injected environment for a target.
  run [options] <target> <command...>           Run a command with injected dotenv environment.
  check [options]                               Run a configured env policy check or target dotenv selector check.
  sync [options] <name>                         Run a configured env value sync.
  sort-file [options] <envFile> <templateFile>  Sort one env file using a template env file.
  sort [options] [key] [envSuffix]              Sort env files using an env-lane config sort section.
  vault                                         Optional unsafe development vault helpers. Requires @env-lane/vault.
  help [command]                                display help for command
